W.note: Tight, clear timeline with ETA, carrier and tracking number and a good aria-expanded header, but it ships open by default, has no reduced-motion handling, and no real next-action beyond demo buttons.

X.note: Segmented progress bar and a rich timeline with a proper switch and good ARIA, but the open state is tall with tiny cramped buttons and a dead gap at the bottom.

Y.note: Compact pill with ETA and count that opens to a multi-parcel tabbed view with copy, carrier and notify, though the opened panel clips the timeline mid-row and feels busy.

Z.note: Compact collapsed toast with a progress hairline expands to a clean full six-step timeline with number, copy and alerts, with Esc, aria-expanded and reduced-motion support.
